rules.trapName: New York Online Cancellation Mechanism Violation
rules.statuteSummary: A consumer who accepts an automatic renewal or continuous service offer online must be allowed to terminate the automatic renewal or continuous service exclusively online, which may include a termination email formatted and provided by the business that a consumer can send without additional information.
rules.disputeTemplate: Under N.Y. Gen. Bus. Law § 527-a(3), New York consumers who enroll online must be provided an exclusive online cancellation mechanism. Refusing online cancellation is an explicit statutory violation.

rules.trapName: Failure to Provide 15-to-30 Day Renewal Notice
rules.statuteSummary: If an automatic renewal offer has an initial term of 12 months or longer and automatically renews for a term of more than one month, the business must provide clear and conspicuous written notice 15 to 30 days before the renewal date stating that the renewal will occur.
negativeExceptions: notice 15 to 30 days prior to renewal
rules.disputeTemplate: Under N.Y. Gen. Bus. Law § 527-a(2), contracts of 12 months or longer that auto-renew require formal written notice between 15 and 30 days in advance. Failure to send notice renders the renewal void and unenforceable under § 527-a(4).
